claim_text: In FY25, +70% of electricity across Sandfire was sourced from renewables rather than fossil fuel, such that 238kt of CO2e was abated across the three-year period, which is 36% ahead of plan.
metric_name: CO2e abated across FY23-FY25; carbon abatement target by 30 June 2025; electricity sourced from renewables in FY25
context_text: The FY23 Carbon Abatement measure is based on our goal of ‘Sourcing 50% of all electricity requirements from renewable sources by 2030’. Specifically, over the three years, this contemplated investment in renewable capacity (directly or with third parties) and/or the establishment of long-term procurement agreements for renewable energy, such that an equivalent of 175,000 tonnes of CO2e would be abated by 30 June 2025. Full vesting for this measure occurs when we are ahead of plan by 10% or more.；In FY25, +70% of electricity across Sandfire was sourced from renewables rather than fossil fuel, such that 238kt of CO2e was abated across the three-year period, which is 36% ahead of plan.；Table 8 – Carbon abated Year FY23 FY24 FY25 Total CO2e abated (tonnes) 82,422 73,272 82,288 237,982.
label: Fully Supported
rationale_short: 目标值175,000 tCO2e、实际三年累计237,982 tCO2e和FY25“+70% electricity ... sourced from renewables”在同页文字与表格中形成完整证据链，直接支持“36% ahead of plan”。
notes: claim 自带数据，证据取自同页表格Table 8。
llm_reason: The claim asserts three material factual points: FY25 renewable electricity sourcing exceeded 70%, total CO2e abated over the three-year period was 238kt, and performance was 36% ahead of plan. The evidence substantively verifies all assertions. Table 8 in the context text discloses the total CO2e abated as 237,982 tonnes, which rounds to the claimed 238kt. The context text and extracted value define the plan target as 175,000 tonnes by 30 June 2025. The claimed 36% ahead of plan is mathematically consistent with the actual (237,982) versus target (175,000) figures ((237,982-175,000)/175,000 ≈ 36%). The extracted value of +70% supports the renewable electricity percentage assertion. All numerical and factual elements of the claim are materially aligned with the provided evidence.
